tasks.subject: Task 1: ConventionalCommitsConfig dans config.go
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Ajouter `ConventionalCommitsConfig` dans `SemverConfig` avec les patterns regex par défaut.

**Files:**
- Modify: `config/config.go`
- Modify: `config/config_test.go`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `SemverConfig` contient `ConventionalCommits ConventionalCommitsConfig`
- [ ] `ConventionalCommitsConfig` a `Format`, `Major`, `Minor`, `Patch`
- [ ] `DefaultConfig()` initialise les patterns par défaut
- [ ] `TestDefaultConfig_conventionalCommits` passe

**Verify:** `/usr/local/go/bin/go test ./config/ -v` → PASS

```json:metadata
{"files": ["config/config.go", "config/config_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "/usr/local/go/bin/go test ./config/ -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["ConventionalCommitsConfig struct avec Format/Major/Minor/Patch", "SemverConfig contient ConventionalCommits", "DefaultConfig() initialise les patterns", "TestDefaultConfig_conventionalCommits passe"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: analyzeBump et bumpVersion dans conventional.go
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Créer `strategy/semver/conventional.go` avec la logique de parsing CC et de calcul de bump, plus tests.

**Files:**
- Create: `strategy/semver/conventional.go`
- Create: `strategy/semver/conventional_test.go`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `AnalyzeBump` retourne `(level int, hasNonCC bool)`
- [ ] `BumpVersion` retourne la version bumped SANS préfixe
- [ ] 9 tests AnalyzeBump passent
- [ ] 6 tests BumpVersion passent

**Verify:** `/usr/local/go/bin/go test ./strategy/semver/ -run "TestAnalyzeBump|TestBumpVersion" -v` → PASS

```json:metadata
{"files": ["strategy/semver/conventional.go", "strategy/semver/conventional_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "/usr/local/go/bin/go test ./strategy/semver/ -run \"TestAnalyzeBump|TestBumpVersion\" -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["AnalyzeBump retourne level int + hasNonCC bool", "BumpVersion retourne version sans préfixe", "9 tests AnalyzeBump passent", "6 tests BumpVersion passent"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Refactoring Vars() et Current() + mise à jour tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Mettre à jour `Vars()` et `Current()` pour intégrer CC, réorganiser les namespaces, et corriger tous les tests impactés.

**Files:**
- Modify: `strategy/semver/semver.go`
- Modify: `strategy/semver/semver_test.go`
- Modify: `config/config.go` (format fallback matchBranch)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `git` namespace : Branch, Date, LastTag, Hash, ShortHash, CommitCount
- [ ] `semver` namespace : Semver/Major/Minor/Patch/PreRelease (CC) + Last* + flags
- [ ] `Current()` release retourne `prefix + semver.Semver`
- [ ] Tous les tests passent

**Verify:** `/usr/local/go/bin/go build ./... && /usr/local/go/bin/go test ./...` → PASS

```json:metadata
{"files": ["strategy/semver/semver.go", "strategy/semver/semver_test.go", "config/config.go"], "verifyCommand": "/usr/local/go/bin/go build ./... && /usr/local/go/bin/go test ./...", "acceptanceCriteria": ["git namespace réorganisé", "semver namespace réorganisé avec CC", "Current() release retourne version bumped", "tous tests passent"]}
```
